skill.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skill.use: Applied its visible hierarchy, control-boundary, feedback and legibility principles within the frozen design; no skill search script was run.

review_method.original_image_review: Actually opened each of the 17 listed candidate original PNG paths and each of the 17 corresponding original reference paths with tools.view_image. Both portrait fullscreen candidate paths were opened even though their declared PNG hashes are identical.
review_method.scale: Compared native 930x1240 portrait and 1240x930 landscape captures against the corresponding factor-two physical references. Native candidate files were not resized, repainted or cropped. Tool-side display downscaling of the references is documented in reference_viewing_records.
review_method.scope: Each case JSON, state sidecar, capture metadata, action file and log was statically read. Geometry, text hierarchy, outlines, clipping, whitespace and visible selected/error/disabled states were assessed independently of stored mechanical pass flags.
review_method.closed_reader_precedence: The user's artwork-only override takes precedence over reference footer, ribbon and status decorations. The fullscreen-footer original was viewed, but restoring its footer is not requested.
review_method.data_rule: Actual artwork, chapter titles, memberships, counts, dates and preference values can differ from samples; these differences do not waive geometry, legibility, control boundaries or truthful state.
review_method.behavior_boundary: Static appearance and stored replay/state support are reported separately. Screenshots do not establish invisible hitboxes or physical/runtime behavior.
review_method.local_activity: Static text reads, original-image viewing and writing this report only. No local or remote application/test/build/probe/validation, SSH, copying or image processing was performed.
review_method.historical_review_boundary: No old candidate pixels or old verdicts were used. This reference batch does not close historical findings and is not the independent regression task.
review_method.readability: All visible controls and text in these 34 original-file views were readable enough for the stated checks. No extra original crop is required for this batch.

root_capability_dispositions.decision: Root accepted the honest disabled control and visible Currently unavailable prompt as an allowed capability boundary; it is not a C5 repair defect.
root_capability_dispositions.source: Explicit Root triage relayed by /root/final_validation_delivery/c4_full_review_coordinator during this review.
root_capability_dispositions.limit: This decision does not apply to automatic brightness or any other unadjudicated control. It does not erase the empty intentional_differences list in the frozen cases or substitute for independent geometry review.

suggestions.title: Resolve automatic-brightness applicability explicitly for both Scribe lighting captures
suggestions.observation: Both original references show an automatic-brightness row and toggle; both actual candidates omit that row. The visible frontlight/warmth sliders are readable and agree with stored values. The inspected capability declarations expose frontlight/warmth and deny physical qualification, but do not declare automatic-brightness or ambient-light-sensor support.
suggestions.requested_resolution: Provide a per-control capability disposition tied to the actual captured environment. If automatic brightness is unsupported, explicitly substantiate that omission; if supported and in scope, retain the independent reference requirement and supply the actual reachable control evidence. Root should adjudicate the omission without inferring support or absence from desktop identity alone.
suggestions.not_requested: Do not fake sensor state or restore a control merely to copy the reference's sample state.

unresolved_evidence_gaps.title: Automatic-brightness control omission lacks a specific capability declaration
unresolved_evidence_gaps.missing_evidence: Actual automatic-brightness/ambient-sensor capability or an explicit accepted per-control omission bound for these desktop Scribe captures.
unresolved_evidence_gaps.why_existing_evidence_is_insufficient: physical_hardware_qualified=false and declared manual orientation do not establish whether the automatic-brightness control itself should be available.
unresolved_evidence_gaps.effect_on_verdict: The two visible slider surfaces were reviewed, but reference applicability for the omitted automatic control remains pending. No acceptance is inferred.
